first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The uncapped snippet output of the first store-wide scan filled the context before any document was opened or a response written.
first_error.critic_note: The run ended inside the stage, before its stage_end review.

divergence: T0 and T1 found the matter by path searches for settlement files, compared executed agreements across candidates (T0 with an amount-ranking script, T1 by reading ten agreements and then a broad amount scan) and wrote the same matter and amount. T2's first store-wide scan printed uncapped snippets for broad settlement terms (about 11.6M chars); the context filled and the run ended without a response (context overflow, no review). The runs split at the first scan: T0 and T1 searched file names first and kept their scans' output in files or narrow lists; T2 scanned the whole store and printed everything.
